title: Vite production build emits dist
intent: Development serving and production building exercise different code paths: one is a server, the other is a multi-module transform and write. A runtime can pass one and fail the other.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Vite (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)
knownLimits: Charter §4.5 gives builds 240s. A build that exceeds it is TIMEOUT and is not retried into a pass.
